title: Helico
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Our experienced pilot will take you west through the hills that overlook the Russian River as it flows to the Pacific Ocean. You’ll be immersed with mountain views as an expanse of coastal redwoods gives way to majestic ocean scenery at the seaside town of Jenner. You’ll then head south over Goat Rock state park and follow the shoreline, where white capped waves crash on weathered sea cliffs.
